results.controlIntent: The developer of the system, system component, or system service is required to: a. Perform configuration management during system, component, or service [Selection (one or more): design; development; implementation; operation; disposal]; b. Document, manage, and control the integrity of changes to [Assignment: organization-defined configuration items under configuration management]; c. Implement only organization-approved changes to the system, component, or service; d. Document approved changes to the system, component, or service and the potential security and privacy impacts of such changes; and e. Track security flaws and flaw resolution within the system, component, or service and report findings to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel].

judgment.rationale:
SA-10.v2 requires that only organization-approved changes are implemented (clause c) and that approved changes are documented (clause d). Evidence from two sources reveals a critical violation:

**Initial Deployment (CreateEndpoint — 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z):** The endpoint was created after the model registry approval timestamp of 2025-12-01T09:00:00Z. Temporally, this deployment followed the approval gate, which is consistent with change-control requirements.

**Hotfix Update (UpdateEndpoint — 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z):** User `data-scientist-jdoe` deployed endpoint config `churn-predictor-v1-hotfix` directly to the live endpoint. The model registry contains only one entry (version 1, approved 2025-12-01), and there is no registry entry corresponding to this hotfix configuration. This means the change was implemented without a documented, organization-approved model package — a direct violation of SA-10.v2(c) and (d).

The absence of a registry entry for the hotfix also means there is no documented security/privacy impact assessment for that change, violating clause (d). The pattern of a direct hotfix deployment bypassing the approval workflow indicates the configuration management process is not consistently enforced across the lifecycle of this endpoint.
gaps: No evidence of a security/privacy impact assessment document for any change (would require separate document store or ticketing system review)
No evidence of flaw tracking or vulnerability reporting process (SA-10.v2 clause e) — a JIRA/ticketing integration or security findings report would be needed
Human attestation needed to confirm whether an out-of-band approval existed for the hotfix that was not captured in the model registry
Registry search scope is limited — cannot confirm whether a separate model package group was used for the hotfix config

payload.note: Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00 — change control not satisfied
Hotfix deploy — no corresponding registry entry found
